text_block_list.text:
Special Week injures herself during
training, so I
rush her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Trainer... It looks like I messed
up...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I guess I was so desperate to get
stronger that I
lost sight of what was
around me.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry for being so careless...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry for being so careless...
choice_data_list: 今は治すことだけ考えよう！
今日は休んで、また頑張ればいい！
今日は休んで、また頑張ればいいよ！

text_block_list.name: Special Week
choice_data_list: 今は治すことだけ考えよう！
今日は休んで、また頑張ればいい！
今日は休んで、また頑張ればいいよ！

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Even my mom would say
that it's
better not to rush at a time like
this.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure I get better... so I can
return to
training in tip-top shape.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Sniffle... Heh... I've got so much work to do, and yet...

I make sure Special Week gets some
proper rest
today so that she can resume
her training.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Y-you're right! If I get better quickly,
then it
won't be so hard to make up for
the lost time!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Okay, I'll focus on my recovery today!
See you
tomorrow, Trainer!

I notice that Special Week is still limping
the next
day and order her to rest
another day.

Perhaps my attempt to cheer her up
caused her to
rush her recovery when her
body wasn't ready for
it.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
This is just a tiny obstacle that stands in
the way
of me becoming the top
Umamusume in all of
Japan! I'll break
right through it!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Rahhh! Hurry up and get better! I know
you can
do it, body!

Her self-motivation seems to work, as
she's fully
recovered and ready to train
the very next day.
